# Enterprise Architecture Templates & Checklists

**← Back to [EAP Home](../../README.md) • [Resources](../README.md)**

---

> This directory contains templates and checklists for EA governance gates. Each gate has simple input and output templates to streamline the GainwellNow submission and review process.

[resources/work-templates/README.md#purpose]

### Purpose

<!-- synthesia-video-url: https://share.synthesia.io/78d9d129-384b-4501-9834-87fa8cc1b50b | ../../assets/images/synthesia/templates-thumbnail.png -->

Standardized templates and checklists enable consistent, efficient interactions between the EA practice and the broader community.
page_texts.5:
[resources/work-templates/README.md#benefits]

### Benefits

- **Consistency**: Uniform structure and quality across all EA processes
- **Efficiency**: Reduced time to complete governance and assessment activities
- **Clarity**: Clear expectations for both submitters and reviewers
- **Streamlined Workflows**: Simplified processes for common EA activities
- **Quality Assurance**: Built-in guidance helps ensure complete, accurate submissions
- **Knowledge Capture**: Structured formats preserve decisions and lessons learned

page_texts.6:
[resources/work-templates/README.md#20-template-categories]

## 2.0 Template Categories

The EA practice maintains the following categories of templates:
page_texts.7:
[resources/work-templates/README.md#-artifactsartifactsreadmemd]

### 🎨 [Artifacts](./artifacts/README.md)

Templates for creating and documenting enterprise architecture artifacts including white papers, reference architectures, best practices, architecture guidance, standards, and patterns.
page_texts.8:
[resources/work-templates/README.md#-assessmentsassessmentsreadmemd]

### 📋 [Assessments](./assessments/README.md)

Templates for evaluating EA maturity, compliance, and effectiveness across various domains and capabilities.
page_texts.9:
[resources/work-templates/README.md#-governancegovernancereadmemd]

### 🏛️ [Governance](./governance/README.md)

Templates and checklists for EA governance processes and gates, supporting formal review and approval workflows defined in the [Architecture Governance Framework](../../governance/processes/architecture-governance.md).
page_texts.10:
[resources/work-templates/README.md#-service-design-packageservice-design-packagereadmemd]

### 📦 [Service Design Package](./service-design-package/README.md)

Comprehensive templates for documenting IT services throughout their lifecycle, from requirements through operations and maintenance.
page_texts.11:
[resources/work-templates/README.md#-salessalesreadmemd]

### 💰 [Sales](./sales/README.md)

Templates for the sales and pre-sales process, capturing solution requirements that drive infrastructure sizing, cost estimation, and environment provisioning by ITO.
page_texts.12:
[resources/work-templates/README.md#-workshopworkshopreadmemd]

### 🤝 [Workshop](./workshop/README.md)

Templates and frameworks for conducting effective Enterprise Architecture workshops that drive alignment, decision-making, and strategic outcomes.

---
page_texts.14:
[resources/work-templates/README.md#simple-process]

### Simple Process

1. **Identify Need**: Choose from Artifacts, Assessments, Governance, Sales, Service Design Package, or Workshop templates
2. **Browse Category**: Visit the appropriate template category section
3. **Download Template**: Select and download the template for your use case
4. **Complete Template**: Fill in all required sections
5. **Submit**: Follow submission guidelines for your template type
page_texts.15:
[resources/work-templates/README.md#template-elements]

### Template Elements

- **⚠️ Required**: Must be completed for all submissions
- **💡 Recommended**: Should be included when applicable
- **ℹ️ Optional**: May be included based on context

1. **Review Categories**: Explore [Artifacts](./artifacts/README.md), [Assessments](./assessments/README.md), [Governance](./governance/README.md), [Sales](./sales/README.md), [Service Design Package](./service-design-package/README.md), and [Workshop](./workshop/README.md) templates
2. **Understand Framework**: See [Architecture Governance Framework](../../governance/processes/architecture-governance.md)
3. **Contribute**: Help build out the template library
